title: introduce-span-burst-detector-and-dynamic-alert-bands
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: production token spikes and short-lived bursts have been generating noisy SLO alerts and masking real regressions. This PR adds a lightweight span-burst detector that tags invocations with a burst-score, surfaces a per-model coldstart histogram, and introduces dynamic alert bands that auto-adjust thresholds based on recent steady-state variance. The goal is to reduce noisy pager churn while preserving sensitivity to sustained regressions.

What I changed (summary): added detection logic in the runtime telemetry pipeline, exported a new metric (redwood.observability.span_burst_score) with compact labels, added a dashboard panel for burst distribution and model startup fidelity, created a Prometheus alert rule template for dynamic alert bands, and wired a simple autotune proposal in the alerts service to recommend new thresholds for on-call review. Includes unit and e2e smoke tests for the detector and CI integration.

Why this is different: instead of rigid static thresholds we compute short-window variance and dampen alerts for single-shot bursts while keeping multi-window correlation checks that still trigger escalations for sustained cost/latency degradation. The implementation is intentionally compact to limit cardinality and memory overhead in streaming telemetry.

Checklist: - [x] Telemetry schema bump and migration notes - [x] Unit tests for burst detector logic - [x] Dashboard JSON and annotated panels - [x] Prometheus rule and example alert-bands config - [x] Integration smoke test against local docker-run observability stack - [x] Design doc link: https://linear.app/redwood/board/observability/post/ENG-9251-burst-detection

release_notes: Add span burst scoring telemetry, a model startup fidelity dashboard, and dynamic alert bands to reduce noisy SLO alerts. Provides an autotune proposal feature to assist on-call in threshold adjustments. No breaking changes.
notes_for_ops: Metrics schema bump requires a short migration window: update ingest pipeline to accept span_burst_score (see metrics_v2.yaml). Alert teams should review autotune proposals before enabling automated rebind. Rollout plan: enable metric production in canary region for 48h, evaluate alert volume delta, then ramp to global.
